title: 第八十六章 一下子被解决了第八十五章 长老团的罪恶
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
看见忍者们情绪激动，三代心中一沉，不好了！便是深深的皱着眉头，站了出去“四代的死，那是因为九尾，波风冥帝完全捏造事实。”
看三代这么做，波风冥帝已经彻底对三代失望了！而其他忍者看三代那着急的样子，也是隐隐觉得波风冥帝说的是真的！
察觉到其他忍者们依旧质疑的目光，三代心中也是慌了，这么多年，第一次慌了！便是急忙高声道“你们要相信木叶，相信我，相信长老团。”
波风冥帝不由的叹了口气“三代，你说什么都没用，你以为忍者没有思想吗？他们也有他们自己的想法，他们不是白痴！”
如今的三代，已经随着木叶而腐朽了。冥帝还是敬佩年轻时候的三代，那时候的他，曾经让木叶登上了巅峰！
可是现在年迈了，人也已经老顽固了。
三代听到冥帝的话，脸色沉了下来，一脸痛苦道“冥帝，这可是你父亲水门用生命呵护的木叶，你难道想看到木叶因此而走向下坡！”
“走向下坡？”闻言，波风冥帝不由又是笑了起来“现在的木叶，已经在走下坡路了！如果再不做出革命，我想它迟早要经历一次毁灭。”
“你胡说什么？”三代忍不住怒气冲冲了起来“波风冥帝，我再说一次，这可是你父亲水门用生命所守护的木叶。”
“我父亲？你还有脸提起我的父亲吗？”波风冥帝微微一笑，哼道“我的父亲！你知道当年的真相吧，为什么不早说呢？”
闻言，三代脸色不由一愣，一脸犹豫，不知道该说什么才好！十二年前，他也认为事情，其实就是那么一回事！
但是后代调查，三代才知道原来长老团内有人给一个神秘组织透露了玖辛奈临盆的时间，而也就在玖辛奈临盆那天，九尾袭击了村子。
三代知道，那不是巧合！
水门的死，是长老团间接设计害死的！现在波风冥帝这么质问自己，让的三代脸色微微出现了愧疚之色！
“怎么？要我说出来吗？”冥帝喝到，鸣人也是拳头紧握。
“不！”三代急忙制止！
看三代那样子，在场忍者都是不由的心中一动！他们已经想到了某一种的可能性！
四代的死！
不是偶然！
“你怕了吗？三代！”波风冥帝呵呵笑道“如果是正确的事情，怎么怕被人知道？现在我就该告诉所有人，木叶的真正面目了！”

“不要！”三代更是情绪高昂的叫了起来。可波风冥帝根本不想理会三代，继续道“水门老爸的死，完全是长老团所设计的！”
这句话一出，全场忍者都是大吃一惊！就是大名，也是一傻！他也没想到原来木叶的政治也这么黑暗！
就是曾经的四代，原来也陨落在了自己人设计之中！
“人柱力在分娩的时刻，这是封印最薄弱的时候，而玖辛奈老妈临盆的时间一直都是秘密，而且还是突然的事情！除了一些掌握情报的人之外，谁还知道？可是，在我母亲临盆的那一晚，一个带着螺旋面具的神秘人进攻，将玖辛奈老妈掳走，将九尾释放出来，并且最终害得水门老爸封印九尾而战死，玖辛奈老妈查克拉耗尽而亡，请问，这到底是怎么回事？”
波风冥帝的话一出，众人都想到了长老团，特别是团藏！要是水门一直活着，水门年轻力壮，团藏这辈子都没机会成为火影了！
content_en:
Seeing the excitement of the ninjas, Sandai's heart sank, this is not good! He frowned deeply and stood up, "The Yondaime's death was because of Kyuubi and Namikaze Hades completely fabricating the facts."
Seeing the third generation doing this, Emperor Namikaze has been completely disappointed with the third generation! Seeing the anxious look of the third generation, the other ninjas also vaguely felt that what Namikaze Hades said was true!
Noticing that the other ninjas were still looking at him with doubts, the third generation also panicked. For the first time in so many years, he panicked! He hurriedly said loudly, "You must believe in Konoha, believe in me, and believe in the elders."
Namikaze Hade couldn't help but sigh, "Sandai, it's useless what you say. Do you think ninjas don't have thoughts? They also have their own ideas. They are not idiots!"
Today's three generations have decayed with Konoha. Emperor Hades still admired Sandai when he was young. At that time, he once brought Konoha to the top!
But now that I am old, I have become stubborn.
After hearing Ming Emperor's words, Sandai's face darkened, and he said with a painful look on his face, "Ming Emperor, this is the Konoha that your father Minato has protected with his life. Do you want to see Konoha go downhill because of this!"
"Going downhill?" Hearing this, Emperor Namikaze couldn't help but laugh again. "Konoha is already going downhill! If we don't make a revolution, I think it will experience destruction sooner or later."
"What nonsense are you talking about?" Sandai couldn't help but burst out angrily, "Emperor Namikaze, let me say it again, this is Konoha that your father Minato protects with his life."
"My father? Do you still have the nerve to mention my father?" Namikaze Hades smiled slightly and hummed, "My father! You know the truth back then, right? Why didn't you tell me earlier?"
Hearing this, the third generation couldn't help but look stunned, hesitant, not knowing what to say! Twelve years ago, he also thought that things were actually the same!
However, after investigation by later generations, the third generation found out that someone in the elders revealed the time of Kushina's delivery to a mysterious organization, and on the day of Kushina's delivery, the Kyuubi attacked the village.
Sandai knew that was no coincidence!
Minato's death was indirectly planned by the Elders! Now that Emperor Namikaze is questioning himself like this, the third generation has a slightly guilty look on his face!
"What? Do you want me to tell you?" Emperor Hades shouted, and Naruto clenched his fists.
"No!" Sandai hurriedly stopped!
Seeing the third generation like that, all the ninjas present couldn't help but feel moved! They have already thought of a certain possibility!
The death of the fourth generation!
No accident!
"Are you scared? Sandaime!" Namikaze Hades chuckled, "If it is the right thing, why are you afraid of being known? Now I should tell everyone the true face of Konoha!"
"No!" Sandai shouted in high spirits. But Emperor Namikaze didn't want to pay attention to the third generation at all, and continued, "The death of Minato's father was completely designed by the elders!"
As soon as these words came out, all the ninjas in the audience were shocked! Even a famous person is still a fool! He didn't expect Konoha's politics to be so dark!
Even the previous four generations had fallen into the hands of their own people!
"The seal is at its weakest when a Jinchuuriki is giving birth, and the time when Kushina's mother gave birth has always been a secret, and it was a sudden thing! Except for some people who have information, who knows? But when my mother gave birth, One night, a mysterious man wearing a spiral mask attacked, kidnapped Kushina's mother, and released the Kyuubi. In the end, Minato's father sealed the Kyuubi and died in the battle, and Kushina's mother died of chakra exhaustion. What is going on? "
As soon as Namikaze Hade's words came out, everyone thought of the elders, especially Danzo! If Minato had been alive and Minato was young and strong, Danzo would never have the chance to become Hokage in this life!
